next.reason: 1985 GR16: an alternate key 'may be nonunique only if the DUPLICATES phrase is specified', and duplicates are retrieved sequentially 'in the order in which they are released to the MSCS'. 2023 §2023:14.9.51.4 GR40 keeps 'may be non unique only if the DUPLICATES phrase is specified' with retrieval in 'the order in which the operating environment actually writes the record', and §2023:14.9.30.4 GR26 returns duplicates 'in the same order ... in which they are released by execution of WRITE statements'. 'Actually writes' can differ only under 2023 file sharing; the '22' result restates 1985 GR17c/GR18. Same.
